name: Poynting ownership
statement: For Maxwell-Hodge EM, S_i=-T_EM(n,e_i); EM flux is already in the Hilbert stress and c_Poynt_extra=0.
effect: forbids Poynting as a second hidden bulk source

name: closed-collar no-radiation clause
statement: On the static/quasi-static local collar used for Newton/PPN/R10/clock source tests, if Phi_EM_rad=int_boundary S dot n dA=0 over the test window, then Delta_rad_Poynting=0.
effect: open radiative systems keep a finite boundary-flux row

name: orientation/outward-normal owner
statement: If the observed time orientation, volume orientation and outward boundary normal are fixed before variation, Delta_orientation_flux=0 by convention, not by fitting.
effect: if the boundary projector/orientation varies, retain a boundary projector row

name: Dq_EM conditional branch zero
statement: 4261 closes the action-domain/Hodge branch, 4262 closes readout/coupling leaks, and 4263 closes the closed-collar radiative/orientation guard; therefore Dq_EM=0 in this standard local branch.
effect: conditional branch input only; not a public local-GR claim

name: open-boundary fallback
statement: If Phi_EM_rad != 0, use epsilon_rad_EM=|Phi_EM_rad|/(M_H c^2/Delta tau) plus any orientation/projector variation as a no-cancellation boundary bound.
